lines.ja: 問題。世界一ヒマな係は、どこでしょう
lines.en: Question. Which unit has the most free time in the world?

lines.ja: 特務トレンド係!! 正解ッ!!
lines.en: The Special Trends Unit!! CORRECT!!

lines.ja: 十一月はじめ。梨ヶ坂市役所・地下。特務トレンド係。
lines.en: Early November. Nashigasaka City Hall, the basement. The Special Trends Unit.

lines.ja: 勤務中に、何を鳴らしてるの!!
lines.en: What are you buzzing on the clock for!!

lines.ja: 百円ショップの早押しブザーだ。いい音だろ
lines.en: Hundred-yen-shop quiz buzzer. Sweet sound, huh?

lines.ja: 課長は、本庁の会議です
lines.en: The Chief's in a meeting at the head office.

lines.ja: 梨まつり、今週末みたいですね
lines.en: Looks like the Pear Festival's this weekend.

lines.ja: 地下の係ってのは、ここかい!!
lines.en: This the basement unit, is it!!

lines.ja: 梨まつりの実行委員長、西条だよ
lines.en: I'm Saijo, chair of the Pear Festival committee.

lines.ja: 目玉の職員対抗クイズ王に
lines.en: Our big draw is the staff quiz championship,

lines.ja: 出る人がいないのさ
lines.en: and nobody's signed up, see.

lines.ja: それで、なぜ地下に……？
lines.en: So... why come down to the basement?

lines.ja: 地下の係はいつも暇そうだって
lines.en: Folks say the basement unit always looks like it's got nothing to do.

lines.ja: 掃除の人に聞いたよ
lines.en: Heard it from the cleaning lady.

lines.ja: で、ここは何をする係なんだい？
lines.en: So what is it this unit actually does?

lines.ja: ……ヒマを、する係？
lines.en: ...A unit for... having free time?

lines.ja: 優勝賞品は、商店街の協賛でね
lines.en: The grand prize is sponsored by the shopping street.

lines.ja: 商品券十万円分と、梨一年分
lines.en: 100,000 yen in vouchers, plus a year's supply of pears.

lines.ja: 待って。職員が賞品を？
lines.en: Wait. City staff winning prizes?

lines.ja: 休みの日の、まつりの余興だよ
lines.en: It's a sideshow at the festival, on your day off.

lines.ja: じゅ、十万ッ……
lines.en: A h-hundred grand...

lines.ja: 出る!! 出てやるよ、クイズ王!!
lines.en: I'm in!! I'll be your quiz king!!

lines.ja: 新高は十月でおしまい。いまは新興さ
lines.en: Niitaka's done by October. Now it's Shinko season.

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂市・西条梨園。
lines.en: Saijo Pear Orchard, Nashigasaka City.

lines.ja: 遅くまで穫れる、うちの最後の梨だよ
lines.en: Ripens late. The last pear we pick all year.

lines.ja: でけえ!! 顔くらいあるぞ!!
lines.en: It's HUGE!! Big as my face!!

lines.ja: 業務外ですね。テツさんの付き添い、日当千円です
lines.en: This is off duty. Escorting you is 1,000 yen a day, Tetsu.

lines.ja: それは、まつりの分だよ!!
lines.en: Those are for the festival!!

lines.ja: まつりのお客さん、何人くらいですか
lines.en: How many visitors does the festival get?

lines.ja: 年々減ってね。去年は
lines.en: Fewer every year. Last year,

lines.ja: お客より、スタッフのほうが多かった
lines.en: there were more staff than guests.

lines.ja: ……笑えない
lines.en: ...That's not funny.

lines.ja: 四十年前、じいさんが始めたまつりさ
lines.en: My late husband started this festival forty years ago.

lines.ja: 町のみんなに、梨を食べてほしいってね
lines.en: Said he wanted everybody in town to eat pears.

lines.ja: ……今年で、終わりにしようかと思ってね
lines.en: ...I'm thinking this year'll be the last one.

lines.ja: 有名人を呼ぶとか、広告を出すとか――
lines.en: You could book a celebrity, or run some ads...

lines.ja: 予算はね、ゼロ
lines.en: Budget's zero, dear.

lines.ja: 梨だけに、まつりも「無し」か!!
lines.en: Nashi festival? More like NOTHING festival!!
lines.note: "Nashi," the Japanese word for pear, sounds exactly like "nashi," meaning "none" or "nothing."

lines.ja: 縁起でもない。梨は「ありのみ」って呼ぶんだよ
lines.en: Bite your tongue. That's why we call pears "ari-no-mi"!
lines.note: Because of that unlucky pun, pears are traditionally also called "ari-no-mi," the "having fruit" (ari = there is).

lines.ja: 赤嶺。クイズで客が一番湧くのは、いつだと思う
lines.en: Akamine. When does a quiz crowd go wildest?

lines.ja: ……正解したとき？
lines.en: ...When someone gets it right?

lines.ja: ちがう。問題の途中で当てたときだ
lines.en: Nope. When someone nails it before the question's even done.

lines.ja: 途中で当てりゃ、客は勝手に集まる!!
lines.en: Nail 'em halfway, and the crowd shows up on its own!!

lines.ja: そしておれが優勝!! 十万!! 梨一年分!!
lines.en: And then I WIN!! A hundred grand!! A year of pears!!

lines.ja: ……係の名前が、市じゅうに
lines.en: ...Our unit's name, all over the city...

lines.ja: ……応援団長なら、私がやるわ
lines.en: ...Fine. I'll be your head cheerleader.

lines.ja: ルールは「早押し、早い者勝ち」だそうです
lines.en: The rule is "buzzer quiz, fastest finger wins."

lines.ja: 問題は、実行委員長が作るそうです
lines.en: And the committee chair writes the questions herself.

lines.ja: 早い者勝ち……
lines.en: Fastest finger wins...

lines.ja: 問題なんざ、最後まで聞くやつが遅え!!
lines.en: Anybody who waits for the whole question is too slow!!

lines.ja: ……ばあちゃんの問題なら、全部おれらが聞いた話だ
lines.en: ...Granny's questions? It's all stuff she already told us.

lines.ja: ……そうかしら
lines.en: ...Is that so.

lines.ja: 練習、しないんですか
lines.en: You're not going to practice?

lines.ja: 勉強なんざ、したやつの負けだ
lines.en: Studying is for losers.

lines.ja: さあ、始まるよ
lines.en: Alright, here we go!

lines.ja: 職員対抗・梨ヶ坂クイズ王決定戦!!
lines.en: The Staff Showdown: Nashigasaka Quiz King Championship!!

lines.ja: そして土曜。今年最後の、梨まつり。
lines.en: Then Saturday. The last Pear Festival of the year.

lines.ja: 予算の端数、一円も逃しません
lines.en: Not one stray yen of the budget escapes me.

lines.ja: 財政課　電卓の鬼
lines.en: Finance Division: The Calculator Demon

lines.ja: どんな届出も、笑顔で受けます
lines.en: Any filing, any form, accepted with a smile.

lines.ja: 市民課　窓口二十年の鉄人
lines.en: Citizens Division: 20-Year Counter Iron Man

lines.ja: 中の人などいません
lines.en: There is no one inside this costume.
lines.note: A classic Japanese running joke: official mascots always insist there is no person inside the costume.

lines.ja: 観光課　ゆるキャラの中の人
lines.en: Tourism Division: The Person Inside the Mascot

lines.ja: 十万は、おれのもんだァ……
lines.en: That hundred grand is MIIINE...

lines.ja: 特務トレンド係　地下のヒマ人
lines.en: Special Trends Unit: Basement Slacker

lines.ja: ……梨、うまいな
lines.en: ...Man, these pears are good.

lines.ja: ルールは早押し。正解で一点だよ
lines.en: It's a buzzer quiz. One point per right answer.

lines.ja: 客席のみなさんも、答えていいよ
lines.en: Folks in the audience can answer too.

lines.ja: 正解したら、市民枠で賞品だ
lines.en: Get one right and you win a prize, citizen's slot.

lines.ja: ……テツ、押しなさい
lines.en: ...Tetsu, push the button.

lines.ja: テツさん。日当、まだです
lines.en: Tetsu. You still owe me today's 1,000.

lines.ja: 地下の係か。君のところだな
lines.en: The basement unit, eh? That's yours, isn't it.

lines.ja: はい。……私は、見るだけですので
lines.en: Yes. ...I am only here to watch.

lines.ja: それじゃ予選、第一問!!
lines.en: Now then, preliminaries, question one!!

lines.ja: 客がいねえほうが、集中できるぜ
lines.en: No crowd? Easier to focus.

lines.ja: 問題。梨は『無し』に通じるのを嫌って――
lines.en: Question. Because "nashi" sounds like "nothing," people avoid the word and call pears--

lines.ja: ありのみ!!
lines.en: ARI-NO-MI!!

lines.ja: ……正解。あんた、聞いてたね
lines.en: ...Correct. You were listening, weren't you.

lines.ja: ま、まだ問題の途中……
lines.en: B-but she wasn't done with the question...

lines.ja: 問題。関東の目安で、幸水は八月、豊水は九月ごろ
lines.en: Question. In the Kanto area, Kosui comes around August, Hosui around September.
lines.note: Kosui, Hosui, Niitaka and Shinko are Japanese pear varieties that ripen in roughly that order, from August into late autumn.

lines.ja: では、十月ごろが旬の――
lines.en: So which variety is in season around October--

lines.ja: 新高!!
lines.en: NIITAKA!!

lines.ja: 予選　源田テツ　十問連続正解
lines.en: Preliminaries: Tetsu Genda, 10 correct in a row

lines.ja: ……見なかったことにします
lines.en: ...I'll pretend I didn't see that.

lines.ja: なんだ、あの兄ちゃん!?
lines.en: Who IS that guy!?

lines.ja: 途中で答える兄ちゃんがいるぞ!!
lines.en: Some guy's answering before the question's over!!

lines.ja: ……じいさん。客席が、埋まってるよ
lines.en: ...Dear. The seats are full.

lines.ja: ……汗ふき用だ。使っとけ
lines.en: ...That's for sweat. Use it.

lines.ja: 来年から、このまつりはおれの番組だ!!
lines.en: Starting next year, this festival is MY show!!

lines.ja: 特務トレンド係ー!! 地下の星ー!!
lines.en: Special Trends Uniiit!! Star of the basemeeent!!
...Huh?

lines.ja: 調子、乗りましたね
lines.en: Now he's getting cocky.

lines.ja: 番組か。いい度胸だ
lines.en: "His show," is it. Bold.

lines.ja: なら、相手役が要るな
lines.en: Then he'll need someone to play against.

lines.ja: 決勝の相手は、特務トレンド係……
lines.en: Your opponent in the final, from the Special Trends Unit...

lines.ja: 豪徳寺剛さん!!
lines.en: Mr. Gotokuji!!

lines.ja: ……部長。私は、梨ジュースを飲みに来ただけで
lines.en: ...Director. I only came for some pear juice.

lines.ja: か、課長ォ!?
lines.en: Ch-Chieeef!?

lines.ja: 課長、ジュース持ったままです
lines.en: Chief, you're still holding your juice.

lines.ja: 問題。夜間や休日でも、市役所の守衛室で――
lines.en: Question. Even at night or on holidays, the city hall security office will--

lines.ja: 決勝　五問先取
lines.en: Final: First to Five

lines.ja: 落とし物!!
lines.en: LOST PROPERTY!!

lines.ja: ――預かってもらえる、結婚のときの届は？
lines.en: --hold on to it for you: which form do you file when you get married?

lines.ja: 婚姻届です
lines.en: A marriage registration.

lines.ja: 解説：戸籍の届は、夜間・休日も預かり。審査は開庁日
lines.en: Explainer: Family register forms are accepted at night and on holidays. Review happens on the next business day.
lines.note: In Japan, marriage and other family-register forms can be left with a city hall's night/holiday desk (often the security office); staff review them on the next business day.

lines.ja: ……最後まで聞きゃ、おれでも分かったじゃねえか
lines.en: ...If I'd listened to the end, even I'd have gotten that!

lines.ja: 四対四
lines.en: 4 to 4

lines.ja: 泣いても笑っても、最終問題!!
lines.en: Win or lose, it's the FINAL QUESTION!!

lines.ja: 最終問題。梨ヶ坂市役所・特務トレンド係の――
lines.en: Final question. Nashigasaka City Hall's Special Trends Unit--

lines.ja: 特務トレンド係の……!!
lines.en: The Special Trends Unit's...!!

lines.ja: ――設置の目的は、何でしょう？
lines.en: --what is its official purpose?

lines.ja: ……ヒマを、する係？
lines.en: ...A unit for... having free time?

lines.ja: ……自分の係の問題には
lines.en: ...On a question about my own unit,

lines.ja: 答えるわけにはまいりません
lines.en: I'm afraid I cannot answer.

lines.ja: ……私も、知らない……
lines.en: ...I don't know either...

lines.ja: 課長が答えないのは、筋だ
lines.en: The Chief declining to answer is only proper.

lines.ja: ……だが、部下が自分の係を言えんとはね
lines.en: ...But his own staff can't say what their unit is for?

lines.ja: ……廃止を、検討しようか
lines.en: ...Perhaps we should consider abolishing it.

lines.ja: は、廃止ィィ!?
lines.en: A-ABOLISH ITTT!?

lines.ja: 世間の流行を、市の仕事に取り込むため
lines.en: To bring the world's trends into the city's work.

lines.ja: こ、小僧ォ!? なんで知ってる!!
lines.en: Y-you BRAT!? How do you know that!!

lines.ja: 時給の根拠を、確かめたので
lines.en: I looked up what my hourly wage is based on.

lines.ja: 市民枠、正解!! 賞品は全部、この子に!!
lines.en: Citizen's slot, CORRECT!! All the prizes go to this kid!!

lines.ja: 部長には、私から申し上げました
lines.en: I have spoken to the Director myself.

lines.ja: 週明け。係室。
lines.en: The next week. The unit's office.

lines.ja: 廃止は、鈴木くんに免じて、なしです
lines.en: The abolition is off, as a favor to Suzuki.

lines.ja: た、助かった……
lines.en: S-saved...

lines.ja: 新興を一つもぐたびに、設置の目的を一回。百回です
lines.en: For each Shinko pear you pick, recite the unit's purpose once. One hundred times.

lines.ja: ひゃ、百回ィ!?
lines.en: A H-HUNDRED!?

lines.ja: え、わ、私も……入って……る……？
lines.en: W-wait, am I... included... too...?

lines.ja: 私も、唱えます
lines.en: I shall recite it as well.

lines.ja: 一回目ェ!! 世間の流行をォ!!
lines.en: NUMBER ONE!! To bring the world's TRENDS--!!

lines.ja: 週末。西条梨園。
lines.en: The weekend. Saijo Pear Orchard.

lines.ja: ……四十八回目。取り込むため……
lines.en: ...Forty-eight. Into the city's work...

lines.ja: ……九十九……
lines.en: ...Ninety-nine...

lines.ja: 世間の流行を、市の仕事に取り込むため
lines.en: To bring the world's trends into the city's work.

lines.ja: 来年も、クイズはやるよ
lines.en: We're doing the quiz again next year.

lines.ja: ……百回目。取り込むため……
lines.en: ...One hundred. Into the city's work...

lines.ja: ……おれの賞品は？
lines.en: ...What about MY prize?

lines.ja: ゼロだよ!! それは、この子の梨一年分さ!!
lines.en: Zero!! These are this kid's year of pears!!

lines.ja: 今月の分、受け取りに来ました
lines.en: I'm here to pick up this month's share.
